Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision
you reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd ratehr just give you the details of what happened, if that's all right.
Q: That's fine. We'll get to the details. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle you were
operating at the time?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car.
Q: Where exactly did the collision occur?
A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Sugar Land, near the main entrance. I was pulling out of a space in the
middle row.
Q: What time of day was it?
A: It was in the afternoon, maybe around three or so, and the lot was fairly busy.
Q: Describe how the collision happened.
A: I was backing out slowly, looking over my shoulder. Another vehicle came down the aisle and its rear corner
clipped the back of my car. I stopped rgiht away. I don't think either of us was going very fast.
Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?
A: Briefly. We exchanged information and they seemed apologetic.
Q: How are you feeling since the collision?
A: My neck is really stiff, and I've had headaches. Turning my head to check mirrors hurts. The doctor said it looks
like whiplash.
Q: Have you received any treatment so far?
A: Yes, I've been going to physical therapy twice a week and I'm taking anti-inflammatory medication.
Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this collision?
A: Not that I'm aware of. I'd been fine.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible, since the treatment is costing me time off work.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
